_help.about: CludeGods settings. install.sh copies this file to ~/.voicemode/call/config.json once, if that file is absent, and never overwrites it. Every key is optional: a missing file, a missing key, or a value not listed here means the default. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_help.approvals.outward: How Claude takes your yes for an outward action (sending, posting, publishing outside this Mac, deleting, a purchase, an invite). spoken (default): Claude writes the exact action in the chat, reads it back in one sentence, and a clear spoken yes such as 'yes, send it' counts. typed: only a yes typed in the chat counts.
_help.approvals.permission_prompts: Where Claude Code's permission prompts show. app (default): the app's own dialog, as without CludeGods. pill: on CallPill while a call is live, answered only by a mouse click; with no live call the app's dialog shows as usual.
_help.approvals.worker_publish: How workers save Spaces pages. direct (default): a worker may save pages itself (pages new, pages publish, pages mkspace) in the spaces it may write. approve: workers save drafts and a page lands only on your Approve in the Workers pane. Either way Memory changes are drafts you approve, and a worker with the drafts or read preset never publishes.
_help.user_label: How your turns are labelled on a call. Default USER.
_help.workers.default_tools: The tools preset a new worker gets: full (default), drafts, read, or a list of tool names. drafts and read are opt-in restrictions the guard hook enforces.
